key_insights: Strong signals (BUY count > 5) in early weeks → deploy aggressively
Zero BUY signals for weeks → PM override using classifier P(up) > 90%
Adaptive aggression (0.6x-2.0x) preserved capital during weak periods
Max drawdown only 1.9% — never risk more than 5% of portfolio
First 3 weeks had best returns when RL confidence was highest
Weekly liquidation (buy Tue, sell Thu) works well for NSE
strategy_rules: RULE 1: If RL gives BUY signals, follow the model (trust the edge)
RULE 2: If 0 BUY signals, PM generates picks from classifier + momentum
RULE 3: Never deploy > 98% of capital (always keep min trading fees)
RULE 4: Ramp aggression on winning streaks (let winners compound)
RULE 5: Cut aggression to 0.6x after 2+ consecutive losses
RULE 6: Auto-avoid stocks with avg P&L < -1% after 3+ trades
RULE 7: 3% is the FLOOR — no cap on upside, max risk is 5% drawdown

evidence.statistical_test: p=0.41 — not significant vs Mon→Thu, use Sharpe as tiebreaker

special_rules: Expiry weeks (last week of month) actually perform better for large-caps on Mon→Wed
F&O weekly expiry is Tuesday — never enter/exit on Tuesday
Aug 26 is settlement holiday — adjust that week to Mon→Tue or Mon→Thu
Week 1 of month has best daily returns (+0.10% vs +0.03% mid-month)
